mismatch_tags: In battle-puzzles you get a special set of Black Book pages, with which you need to overcome enemy demons. You can inspect the deck by clicking on the Black Book at the bottom of the screen near the pages that you can cast (or press <sprite name="RightStick">).
谜战期间，你会得到专门的一套黑书书页，要用这些书页战胜敌方邪灵。屏幕底部书页旁边就是黑书，点击即可查看书内其他书页。
Get <sprite name="Defence"> equal to the player's amount of rubles
获得<sprite name="Defense">，数值等于玩家卢布的总数
digit: FoolTutorial1Screen3
Attack Nikolai with this six of hearts.
用这张红桃6打尼古拉。
FoolTutorial2Screen1
At the end of each round the players take turns drawing new cards until they have six in their hand. It starts with the first attacker this round.
每个回合结束的时候，从这一回合第一个出牌的那一家开始，各家依次轮流抓牌，手上抓够6张为止。
FoolTutorial3Screen0
Nikolai attacked you with his eight of clubs. To defend from this card and put it in the discard pile, you need to play a card of the same suit, but one higher in rank.
尼古拉用他的梅花8打了你。要想防住这张牌、让它进入弃牌堆，你需要打出一张花色相同、点数更大的牌。
FoolTutorial3Screen1
Beat the eight of clubs with your nine of clubs.
用手上的梅花9管住梅花8。
FoolTutorial4Screen1
Play the seven of diamonds
打出方块7
FoolTutorial5Screen0
Although Nikolai beat your card with ten of diamonds, you may launch a new attack with a card of the rank that has already been played.
尼古拉用方块10管住了你的牌，不过你可以出一张和桌上牌大小相同的牌，发起新一轮攻击。
FoolTutorial5Screen1
For instance, you now can attack with a ten or with another seven!
比如，你现在可以打一张10，或者再打一张7！
FoolTutorial6Screen2

Note the trump card. The trump suit is stronger than other suits and can beat all the other cards, even those of the different suit and even those that are higher in rank. For instance, a trump ten will even beat a King!
注意王牌。花色和王牌一样的牌强过其他花色的牌，可以管住其他花色任意一张牌，无论点数比它小还是比它大。比如说，一张王牌花色的10可以管住一张K！
FoolCheatingTutorialScreen2

There are only two kinds of zagovors: peek into your opponent's hand and switch a random card in your hand with a random trump card. With weapons like these, you can beat the Devil himself or even a cossack!
只有两种密咒可以选择：1.偷窥对手的手牌；2.将手中一张牌随机换成一张王牌。有了这样的利器，撒旦本尊都会成为你的手下败将，就连哥萨克人都赢不了你！
